title: POSITIVE SOLUTIONS FOR FAMILIES
description: POSITIVE SOLUTIONS FOR FAMILIES Wednesdays, September 30 to November 4, 2026 6:30-8:00 p.m. Virtual Event Positive Solutions for Families is an evidence-based, family-friendly workshop series to…
description_full: POSITIVE SOLUTIONS FOR FAMILIES Wednesdays, September 30 to November 4, 2026 6:30-8:00 p.m. Virtual Event Positive Solutions for Families is an evidence-based, family-friendly workshop series to promote positive and effective parenting behaviors. During this interactive workshop, parents of children birth-5 with an IFSP or IEP will: Learn how to support their child’s social and emotional skills Identify the connection between positive relationships, play, and behavior Discover the importance of using routines and transitions Understand why challenging behaviors occur and how to address them Connect with other families and get free resources Visit registration page . For more information please contact EISFamily@hcpss.org. Facilitated by the HCPSS Office of Early Childhood Special Education. This event aligns with the question about the school or school system offering training about special education issues and being connected with other families for mutual support on the MDSE parent survey that is sent to families of students with an IEP or IFSP annually. Free

title: NAMI FAMILY TO FAMILY
description: NAMI FAMILY TO FAMILY Tuesdays, September 22 to November 10, 2026 7:00-9:30 p.m. Virtual or in person NAMI Office 9650 Santiago Rd, Suite 1 Columbia MD NAMI Family-to-Family is an 8-session…
description_full: NAMI FAMILY TO FAMILY Tuesdays, September 22 to November 10, 2026 7:00-9:30 p.m. Virtual or in person NAMI Office 9650 Santiago Rd, Suite 1 Columbia MD NAMI Family-to-Family is an 8-session educational program for family, significant others and friends of people with mental health conditions. NAMI Family-to-Family not only provides information and strategies for taking care of the person you love, but you’ll also find out that you’re not alone. Recovery is a journey, and there is hope. Visit interest form. https://namihowardcountymd.org/support-and-education/class-interest-form/ For more information or to register, please email SShaver@namihowardcountymd.org . Sponsored by the National Alliance on Mental Illness (NAMI) Howard County. Free
